versions.changelog:
topical-openclaw-setup 0.0.2

- Documented canonical Topical Agent API key format; clarified that UUID/dashes are valid.
- MCP step now always uses https://app.usetopical.com/api/mcp — removed domain prompt/logic.
- Instructs user to register outbound webhook via the Topical portal, not via local config or tools, by default.
- Updated instructions to emphasize OpenClaw only needs local hook path; user handles public URL in portal.
- Added workflow links and clarified connections to @daveangelcode/topical and ClawHub resources.
- Improved wording, ordering, and error-proofing for smoother guided setup.

Initial release — set up end-to-end integration of Topical with OpenClaw.

- Guides the user through connecting Topical MCP tools (pull) and webhook (push) with OpenClaw.
- Provides discovery, config merging, hook transform installation, and secure webhook setup.
- Handles prerequisites, prompts for required API keys, and automates most OpenClaw configuration steps.
- Outputs clear instructions for verifying setup and registering webhooks in the Topical portal.
- Emphasizes secure management of credentials and avoiding config overwrites.
- References pairing with @daveangelcode/topical for post-setup workflows.
